text: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Fire lights it, and what you do can be seen. As a catalyst, the light runs short. Your warmth and wit show in the moment and then fade, and little of it lasts once the evening is over.

Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Fire makes it warm, and people feel what you build. As a catalyst, the warmth runs short, and you want the long shot as much as the steady pay. You lose most on what you leave unclaimed.

Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Fire lights it, and what you do can be seen. In balance, what you make and what you show keep the same pace. Your warmth and wit reach people at the moment they count.

Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Fire makes it warm, and people feel what you build. In balance, the fire burns steady. Whether you reach for something new or hold on to the old, the warmth stays.

Things come in far more easily than they go out. You keep a thing rather than take its space back, and your space fills from the walls in. Whoever shares it with you gets less of it to call their own.
